WHAT SETS US APART
Proven, differentiated technology
▲
BLK3 reusable vehicle
Suborbital launch vehicle: out-of-autoclave carbon composite, low parts count — recovered and reflown.
◆
TRL-9 Type-5 cryo tanks
Linerless composite cryogenic tanks (affiliate Scorpius / SSLC) — lighter and more robust than metal.
☾
Proven on the Moon
Scorpius Type-5 tanks flew as fuel & LOX tanks aboard Intuitive Machines' Odysseus (2024) and Athena landers.
